scope: All 26 published circuit sizes and three algorithm variants attempted on both implementations under a 30-second traced-worker observation budget.

budget.timeout_scope: Entire worker including imports, architecture setup, compilation, observation, and trace serialization; not a compiler-only timeout.

native_adapter: U1 is retained as source P and lowered locally to RZ, matching original CodeGenerator. U2 is encoded as U(pi/2, phi, lambda), with identical original LocalU output. No generated input contains ID.
comparison_policy: Ordered pipeline stages, with atom member order normalized inside parallel batches/actions and numeric tolerance 2e-6; durations alone are not equality evidence.
unresolved: Seven successful pairs first diverge in placement: graphstate_60 A*, graphstate_120/180/200 IDS strict and relaxed. The first differing queue pop or score has not been traced, so no numerical or tie-breaking cause is established.
The paper uses 900 seconds per compilation; this 30-second traced-worker study does not reproduce those timeout results or published runtime speedup ratios.

C++ stage times exclude observation output and report architecture setup separately. Local compilation_s includes construction of Device/DAG records and Atom IR compilation; wall_s includes serialization.
